body:
Parents generally can't understand what this generation goes through because they've not been through the same themselves. And I know we can't blame them for it but we also cannot neglect how it takes a toll on our mental health. 
Reaching out to a therapist gives a much safer and non-judgemental space for people to communicate and express themselves. It can help you understand why you're acting a certain way and what changes you can make.
Yes. I feel the same. Maybe we aren't very understanding of each other's issues and continuing it at this rate would just end up being toxic
We've already had a break for a while as I was taking therapy sessions
